name: Sekrd Security Scanner
description: Enables deep security auditing of web applications directly from AI IDEs including Cursor and Claude Code. Scans URLs for vulnerabilities, returns security scores with SHIP/BLOCK verdicts, and provides specific fix prompts for remediation.

SEKRD_API_KEY.description: API key for unlimited scans on paid plans. Without a key, the server provides 3 free scans per month (IP rate limited). With a key, users get unlimited scans on Scan ($49) or Pro ($29/mo) plans. Obtain a key at https://sekrd.com/dashboard/settings
